interpretation.clock: Numeric Image Id suffix is an ordinal within-file index only. Its ratio to whole-second Game Clock is not a documented camera capture rate; no subsecond timebase is published. Clock reversals and missing clocks are counted. Physical 100ms puck continuity is unassessable.
interpretation.event_alignment: The direct unreflected mapping is frozen from the first-period pilot. Event coordinates are compared to same-game/team/jersey, same-second tracking positions; candidate sign reflections are diagnostics only.
interpretation.identity: Tracking IDs and jerseys are retained as game-scoped identifiers. No cross-game athlete identity is assumed.
interpretation.puck_gap_time: The reported gap ratio uses the Image Id/game-clock proxy and is not a physical elapsed-time measurement.
